price.purpose: The single number on a listing card, tabular numerals.

button.purpose: Button text, 1rem (0.9375 small, 1.0625 large, 1.125 search submit).

ui.purpose: Chips, option pills, specs, label-grid values, search field labels, 0.9375rem.

note.purpose: Captions, errors, notes, footer base line, 0.875rem.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The only easing: arch rise, reveals, hover morphs, button state changes.

motion.name: arch-rise
motion.purpose: Hero arches rise from the ground line in sequence at load.

breakpoints.name: short-desktop

fluidRoot.name: root
fluidRoot.purpose: All sizes over 3px are rem; the page scales with the viewport (18px root at 1920, 22px at 2560).

components.description: Saffron pill for every WhatsApp action.

components.name: Search Panel
components.description: The hero's highlight: titled panel with three selects and a full-width submit. Submit is ink from 640px up, saffron at 639px and below.
components.html: Qual imóvel você procura?
components.css: .ds-busca { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0,1fr)); gap: .75rem .875rem; align-items: end; padding: 1.375rem 1.5rem 1.5rem; background: #f1f4ee; color: #10241c; border-radius: .375rem 3rem .375rem .375rem; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-busca-t { grid-column: 1 / -1; margin: 0 0 .25rem; font: 800 1.9rem/1.1 'Bricolage Grotesque', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.03em; } .ds-campo label { display: block; margin-bottom: .375rem; font-size: .9375rem; font-weight: 700; color: #3b4f44; } .ds-campo select { width: 100%; min-height: 3.625rem; padding: 0 .875rem; border: 2px solid #10241c; border-radius: .75rem; background: #fff; color: #10241c; font: 600 1.0625rem 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-campo select:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #2d4bd6; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-busca-ok { grid-column: 1 / -1; min-height: 3.75rem; margin-top: .25rem; border: 2px solid transparent; border-radius: 62.4375rem; background: #10241c; color: #f1f4ee; font: 700 1.125rem 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .25s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-busca-ok:hover { background: #0d5c41; } .ds-busca-ok:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #2d4bd6; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Top Navigation
components.description: Jardim Green bar, white links with a saffron underline that scales in on hover.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1.75rem; min-height: 4.5rem; padding: 0 1.5rem; background: #0d5c41; color: #fff; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav strong { margin-right: auto; font: 700 1.5rem/1 'Bricolage Grotesque', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.03em; } .ds-nav a { position: relative; padding: .625rem 0; color: inherit; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: .25rem; height: 2px; background: #f5b301; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform .35s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-nav a:hover::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f5b301; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Label Grid
components.description: Signature three-cell Código / Tipo / Bairro grid between ink rules, on every listing.
components.css: .ds-etiqueta { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto auto minmax(0,1fr); margin: 0; border-block: 1.5px solid #10241c; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #10241c; } .ds-etiqueta > div { padding: .5625rem .875rem .5625rem 0; } .ds-etiqueta > div + div { padding-left: .875rem; border-left: 1.5px solid #10241c; } .ds-etiqueta dt { margin-bottom: .25rem; font-size: .75rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; color: #3b4f44; } .ds-etiqueta dd { margin: 0; font-size: .9375rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.2; }

components.description: Photo placeholder with one large quarter-circle corner and a saffron seal.
components.css: .ds-foto { position: relative; width: 15rem; aspect-ratio: 4/5; background: #083d2b; border-radius: 8.25rem .25rem .25rem .25rem; overflow: hidden; transition: border-radius .7s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-foto:hover { border-top-left-radius: 13.2rem; } .ds-selo { position: absolute; right: .875rem; top: .875rem; padding: .375rem .75rem; border-radius: 62.4375rem; background: #f5b301; color: #10241c; font: 700 .75rem/1.2 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; }

narrative.northStar: The Modernist House in Flat Colour
narrative.overview:
The site is one house drawn the way Brazilian modernism drew it: whole regions owned by a single saturated colour, arches standing on a concrete ground line, and a single quarter-circle swung out of an otherwise square photograph. Burle Marx colour fields, Niemeyer curves. Depth is stacking, never lighting: one flat shape overlaps another and that is the whole illusion.

Density is generous and mobile-first. Sections alternate whole colour fields (jardim green, cobalt, concrete, deep green) rather than sharing a neutral page with cards on it. The voice is direct and local, and the interface is built so that one saffron button is always the loudest thing within reach: WhatsApp on most screens, the search submit on a phone's first screen.
keyCharacteristics: Every section owns one flat colour field; no gradient, glass or blur anywhere in the build.
Arches (fully rounded top, square base) and a single large quarter-circle corner are the only large-scale shapes.
Every listing carries the same three-cell label grid (Código, Tipo, Bairro) between ink rules.
Saffron is spent on the screen's primary action, the logo mark and one sun; nothing else.
The hero's highlight is the search panel, not the arches.
The whole page is sized in rem on a fluid root, so it scales up on large screens.
Photos are placeholder stock, marked "Ilustrativo" on each card.

rules.name: The Flat Field Rule
rules.body: A region is one solid colour. Depth comes from overlapping shapes and adjacent fields, never from shadow, gradient, glass or blur.

rules.name: The Saffron Scarcity Rule
rules.body: Saffron marks the screen's primary action, the mark and the sun. It is never a background for a whole section and never decoration for its own sake.

rules.name: The Phone Search Exception
rules.body: At 639px and below the search panel is the primary action of the first screen, so its submit button is saffron and the WhatsApp CTA steps down to a white-outlined ghost button below it. Only one saffron button competes in that viewport; from 640px up the submit is ink and WhatsApp keeps saffron.

rules.name: The Paired Text Rule
rules.body: Light fields take Ink and Ink Soft; green fields take white and Menta; cobalt takes white and Azul Claro. Do not cross the pairs.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Labels, chips and buttons are sentence case at normal tracking. Small caps-style uppercase labels are not part of this system.

rules.name: The Tight Display Rule
rules.body: Bricolage headings run -0.02em to -0.035em tracking and balanced wrapping; body text never does.

rules.name: The Fluid Root Rule
rules.body: Size everything in rem (anything over 3px); never pin a pixel size to a component. Hairlines and focus-ring offsets of 3px or less stay in px.

rules.name: The Layered Colour Rule
rules.body: To raise something, put a different flat colour behind or in front of it. Never add a shadow.

dos: Do give each section a whole flat colour field and keep text on its paired colour set.
Do cut photos with exactly one large quarter-circle corner (or a full arch) and 0.25rem on the rest.
Do keep a single saffron button as the dominant action on any screen: WhatsApp generally, the search submit on the phone first screen.
Do rule every listing with the same Código / Tipo / Bairro label grid.
Do size in rem on the fluid root, keep tap targets at 2.75rem or more and set focus rings by field colour.
donts: Don't add shadows, gradients, glass or blur; layer flat colour instead.
Don't use saffron as a section background or for ornament.
Don't round every corner of a photo; one big curve per piece.
Don't fall back to the real-estate default of navy and gold with a stock hero photo and a bolted-on search bar.
Don't set uppercase tracked kickers or eyebrows above headings; the build has none.
Don't put two saffron buttons in the same phone viewport.
